# Supabase browser SDK

Pinned upstream release: `@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0` (MIT).
Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2.118.0/dist/umd/supabase.min.js
Release: https://github.com/supabase/supabase-js/releases/tag/v2.118.0
SHA-256: `bee24fc29228ed5a370f76a2ba1ca3c399549edad2fef23453c80148856a49af`

This is the unmodified upstream UMD browser bundle, served locally so login does not depend on a third-party CDN request. It includes the upstream session coordinator; no custom bypass lock is installed. The upstream MIT license is included beside it as LICENSE.
